interactionValidActionsForInputConsumer.returns: full canonical interactionValidActions envelope plus slot-0 semantic consumer overlay
interactionValidActionsForInputConsumer.candidate_policy: annotation_only; incompatible or unknown semantic status does not remove canonical candidates

inputPortConsumerEdgeCompatibility.returns: exact graph-step projection plus semantic compatibility when that step consumes external slot 0

edge_projection.external_origin_rule: slot 0 is external only when no prior graph step has written slot 0
edge_projection.non_external_edge: reported as not_applicable rather than inferred or rejected
edge_projection.layer_semantics: never inferred from numerical layer type

invariants: routing projection does not mutate workspace, graph builder, or registry
canonical_valid_actions preserves the full interactionValidActions envelope and underlying action state projection
semantic incompatibility is advisory and never rewrites canonical action availability
edge compatibility applies only when topology origin resolves an input position to the original external slot 0 value
a later read of slot 0 after an earlier step writes slot 0 is internal provenance, not external input
routing projection itself never binds a consumer contract persistently
persistent binding is delegated to agent-input-port-edge-binding.v1 and remains outside routing projection authority
routing projection never authorizes execution or selects an action

semantic_lifecycle.policy: persistent role transitions consume topology-origin and edge-binding provenance without changing routing projection authority
